summary: Manual linear stage: a carriage on two guide rods held in two end blocks on a base plate
assumptions: Rods 240 long, held 20 mm deep in each end block.

subassemblies.name: Linear stage
subassemblies.description: Base plate, end blocks, guide rods and carriage.

parts.name: End block
parts.description: End block 30 x 100 x 40 with two Ø12 H7 bores 60 mm apart, 25 mm above the plate, for the guide rods.

parts.name: Guide rod
parts.description: Ground steel guide rod Ø12 h6 x 240.

parts.name: Carriage
parts.description: Carriage 80 x 100 x 25 with two Ø12 bores 60 mm apart that slide on the guide rods.
